request.style: English, male solo voice with gospel choir, piano, drums, organ, bass, strings, hopeful and solemn, 90 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
At that time Michael shall arise
The great prince who stands guard
Over your people in the dust
In a time of great distress

[Chorus]
Some to everlasting life
Some to shame and contempt
But the wise shall shine
Like the brightness of the firmament

[Verse]
Those whose names are in the book
Will be delivered then
Sleeping in the dust of earth
Awakening once again

[Chorus]
Some to everlasting life
Some to shame and contempt
But the wise shall shine
Like the brightness of the firmament

[Bridge]
Lead many to righteousness
Like the stars forever and ever
Shining bright in the sky
Your reward is forever

[Chorus]
Some to everlasting life
Some to shame and contempt
But the wise shall shine
Like the brightness of the firmament

[Outro]
Like the stars forever and ever
